                                         PURPOSE: This Bulletin establishes documentation requirements for Alteration
                                                         CO, New Building with Existing Elements, and New Building filings
                                                         regarding elevator devices, including drawing requirements,
 OPERATIONAL                                             supporting documents required prior to plan approval, and Certificate
                                                         of Occupancy sign-off requirements.

 ISSUANCE DATE                        SUBJECT(S): Elevator Devices - Code requirements; General Construction
September 22, 2026                                       Drawings requirements; Required Supporting Documents prior to
                                                         Approval; Elevator Signoff for Occupancy request



  RELATED CODE SECTIONS & RESOURCES: BC 3002.4, BC 1009.4, BC 1104.4, BC 1107.4

 I. EFFECTIVE DATE
   Effective Immediately.


 II. BACKGROUND
   The NYC Construction Codes, Federal, and State laws may trigger the requirement to provide an elevator device,
   such as the NYC Building Code (BC) 3002.4 requirement to provide an elevator based on the number of stories or
   the BC 1009.4, BC 1104.4 and BC 1107.4 requirements to provide elevator service as part of an accessible means
   of egress or an accessible route, respectively.


 III. COMPLIANCE AND APPLICABILITY
   This requirement applies to the general construction filings of Alteration CO, New Building with Existing Elements and
   New Building filings.


 IV. SUBMITTAL OF DOCUMENTS
    Applicants filing application types listed in Section III of this bulletin shall comply with all of the following requirements:
    A. Drawings. Drawings shall clearly indicate whether an elevator device is required per the NYC Construction Codes
       or voluntarily provided, or where no elevator device is required and none provided the drawings shall indicate “No
       elevator device is required.” Where an elevator is required or provided, the drawings shall indicate the location and
       construction associated with the elevator enclosure as required by the NYC Construction Codes;
    B. No Elevator Affirmation. Where no elevator device is required based on the scope of work of an application, and
       no elevator device is being installed voluntarily in conjunction with this application, a completed No Elevator
       Affirmation, signed and sealed by a Registered Design Professional using the form in Attachment A, shall be
       uploaded in DOB NOW in Additional Supporting Documents required Prior to plan approval; and
   C. Elevator Occupancy Sign-off Requests. Information entered in the Elevator Information section of the Elevator
      Occupancy Sign-Off Request in DOB NOW shall match the information provided in of the No Elevator Affirmation.
